Metadata.Title: METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN
Metadata.Name: 1440p
Metadata.Note: 2560x1440 native render (checkerboard off) with 3840x2160 output in PS4 Pro mode. The game already runs in Pro mode with a 2560x1440 checkerboard render. No post-process anti-aliasing (the checkerboard resolve was the only one). Enable only one resolution entry.
